caption: The drawing depicts a toy soldier figure positioned centrally on a light, neutral background. The figure has a cylindrical head with a painted face featuring a mustache and beard. The head is topped by a black helmet with brown trim and markings. The torso is painted brown with red accents, including a red "X" or sash across the chest and additional red details on the sides. The arms are straight and painted red, with the left arm holding a long, pointed stick or spear vertically downward, while the right arm is bent upward at the elbow holding a brown object resembling a short sword or paddle. The legs are painted black with a slight shine, depicted together and ending in a flat, rectangular base. There are no other objects or background elements present in the composition.
title: Sailor Jack Whirligig
